annotations.title: Key figures for one Portuguese municipality

description: Returns the key figures of one of Portugal's 308 municipalities, with the source and date of each. They are the IMI rate and history, INE sale price per m² (actual sales), purchasing power, population, licensed dwellings, building cases, new builds. Use it for one municipality; to compare use `compare_municipalities`, inside a city `where_to_live`, for monthly building `construction_barometer`. A figure that is not published is null, not estimated. A name matching two municipalities is refused with candidates.

language.description: Language of the page links and labels; the text summary and field names stay English. uk is accepted as ua.

municipality.description: Municipality name in any case, accents optional (Porto, Lisboa, Vila Nova de Gaia, Matosinhos; Lisbon and Oporto are accepted) or its four-digit code (1312). Close spellings are found; two matches return an `ambiguous` error with candidates

name: municipality_stats

outputSchema.description: Success, or a refusal with an error code. Units: *_cents euro cents, *_eur euros, *_eur_m2 euros per m², *_pct and percent in percent.

title: Key figures for one Portuguese municipality
